description: Search Facebook Marketplace listings by keyword near a latitude and longitude. Returns a list (use cursor when paginated).

availability.description: Optional availability filter for marketplace listings.

condition.description: Optional item condition filter for marketplace listings.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence — not the tool you are calling.

conversation_id.description: Echo the conversation_id from the server's previous response. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it.

count.description: Deprecated alias for `limit`. When both are set, `limit` wins.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous response.

dateListed.description: Optional date-listed filter for marketplace listings. `1`/`last24Hours` both mean the last 24 hours, `7`/`last7Days` both mean the last 7 days, and `30`/`last30Days` both mean the last 30 days — these are separate values Facebook accepts for the same window; prefer the named variants (`last24Hours`, `last7Days`, `last30Days`) for clarity. `all` applies no date filter.

deliveryMethod.description: Optional delivery method filter for marketplace listings.

lat.description: Latitude for the marketplace search location.

limit.description: Optional number of listings to return (1–100). Prefer this over `count`.

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

lng.description: Longitude for the marketplace search location.

maxPrice.description: Optional maximum listing price. Must be greater than or equal to `minPrice` when both are set.

minPrice.description: Optional minimum listing price. Must be less than or equal to `maxPrice` when both are set.

offset.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

query.description: Search query text for marketplace listings.

sortBy.description: Optional sort order for marketplace listings. `suggested`: Facebook's default relevance ranking. `distanceAscend`: nearest first. `creationTimeDescend`: newest listings first. `priceAscend`/`priceDescend`: lowest/highest price first.

trim.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

name: facebook_marketplace_search_list
title: Search Facebook Marketplace listings
